title: Jack Dorsey’s Block made an AI model that talks to you like an awkward new friend
hook_text: Block's new AI sounds oddly human
script:
Jack Dorsey's Block just unveiled a new AI called Dessa.
This model was trained from scratch entirely on human conversation.
Dessa lead Ragavan Thurairatnam shared transcripts showing how the bot interacts.
In these test chats, the AI sounds exactly like an awkward new friend.
The model occasionally produces uncanny, stumbling responses during its trials.
These interactions feel noticeably different from standard, polished AI assistants.
Would you actually enjoy talking to a bot that sounds this weird?
